cumulative_positive.genuine_mutual_support: One constrained conscious grounding relation could explain experience and shared lawfulness; identity-preserving continuation could make intended developmental goods enduring; a defensible good-nature relation could connect value and obligations. These are mutually intelligible explanatory relations, not independent observations.
circularity_prohibitions: Do not assume restoration to defend goodness then cite defended goodness as independent evidence of survival.
Do not assume life-valuing designer preferences to interpret life evidence then count inferred designer as new proof of those same preferences.
Do not treat the desire for enduring significance as evidence that endurance occurs.
Do not reuse phenomenal-gap premise in fundamentality, unity and purpose as three observations.

cumulative_countercase.summary: Selected neural interventions constrain embodiment; retrospective timing/access, variable cultural and distressing content, selection, and repeated recruitment weaken simple testimony-to-afterlife inference. Independent conceptual, identity, intentional and normative bridges remain open. Physical identity, psychophysical laws, plural and impersonal stopping points remain competitors. This is not proof that every case has an established ordinary explanation, that finite meaning exhausts cosmic meaning, or that all alternatives are equally supported.
cumulative_countercase.scope: Claims about stronger missing original defenders/replies are withheld.
